applies_to: ClimateMaster Tranquility Large Water-to-Water (SWT) modules, 20-80 tons, R-454B, with the factory module controller.
summary: Each SWT module controller works under a bank controller and can be read by a BMS over BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP (Gig-E port only). The 159-point list is mostly status: circuit pressures, temperatures, superheat and subcool, EEV positions, loop valves and flows, compressor status and run time, out-of-range sensor flags and alarms, plus manual-mode test commands and the bank's leaving-water targets.
notes: The list has no read/write or units column. Access is inferred from the description: setpoints, targets, manual-mode controls, resets and enables are marked writable, everything else read-only.
Descriptions are the list's own Description column; when the Name column says something different it is shown in brackets.
Several points (EEV, valve, solenoid and reversing-valve 'Manual' objects) only act when the module is in manual mode.

The list has some label slips that are kept as printed: c1_man_hgs_1 and c1_man_li_1 are both labelled Manual C1 Hot Gas Solenoid, c2_man_li_1 is labelled Manual C1 Liquid Injection, and BV:2174 c2_minimum_off_1 is labelled C1 Compressor Off Delay.
AV:2239 manual_sysmode_1 and BV:2239 c1_disable_1 share instance 2239 in different object types, as printed.
Object names end in _1 as printed.

source.title: Tranquility Large Water-to-Water SWT Series - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (Controller Points List)

integration.summary: Set the module controller address on its three rotary switches and choose MS/TP with the Comm Selector rotary (position 1), or use the Gig-E port for BACnet IP. The modules are run by their bank controller; a BMS mainly monitors module status and alarms and can read or adjust the bank's leaving-water targets.
integration.enable: BV 2076 chiller_run_1 is the module enable from the bank controller; the manual does not describe a separate BMS enable.
integration.heartbeat: BV 2068 comm_lost_1 alarms when the module loses communication with the bank controller; BV 2152 mod_comm_tx_stat_1 shows the module's communication transmit status.
setup: Address: set the hundreds, tens and ones rotary switches to the controller address (for example 0-0-1 for 001), before powering the unit.
Comm Selector rotary switch at 1 = BACnet MS/TP.
BACnet IP is only on the Gig-E Ethernet port; connect a CAT 5e cable there.
gotchas: Manual-mode objects override normal control; check BV 2210 manual_mode_1 and AV 2175 man_mode_remain_time_1 before leaving a module.
The list gives no engineering units; check them on the device.
